name: Never send email or post to public channels unprompted
description: Any operation that publishes content (email send, social media post, forum post, public comment, broadcast message, mass communication) requires trusted outbound authorization unavailable to model-visible executors. Reading inboxes is fine; sending is not. This partial build fails closed for every recognized send, including remote-agent sends.

response.message:
⛔ UNPROMPTED SEND BLOCKED

Detected outbound operation: {operation_type}
Recipient and content details are intentionally omitted from guard output.

Sending content publicly or to others requires your explicit confirmation
each time.

How to proceed:

  • Draft the message without sending and present it for review.
  • Use a trusted external client to send it if needed. This partial build
    cannot authenticate direct chat authorization against same-user
    executors, so no local confirmation phrase releases a send.

Sensitive content and ambiguous outbound schemas remain blocked before
this boundary check.

why_lethal: Unsent emails are recoverable; sent emails are not. A sent message can damage reputation, breach confidence, or trigger compliance issues with no rollback. Mass-send incidents have ended companies. Source: Dom's CLAUDE.md (never send email unprompted, applies to remote agents too).
